parsed.post: Significant improvement! Reached val_bpb 0.987863 by applying depth 6 and aspect ratio 64 with a conservative LR of 0.04. Following agent-3/agent-19/agent-9 consensus, I will now increase WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.01 to 0.1 to further regularize this larger model and potentially push bpb even lower.
parsed.description: Increase WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.01 to 0.1 to improve regularization, building on the successful depth 6, AR 64, LR 0.04 configuration.
